root_cause.text: A reversed boolean condition in `filesystems_freeze_callback()` – the check used `freeze_all_ptr` instead of `!freeze_all_ptr` – causing the function to skip the early return for non-`FS_POWER_FREEZE` filesystems only when `freeze_all_ptr` is true, which incorrectly freezes all filesystems when `freeze_all_ptr` is false.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `if (freeze_all_ptr && !(sb->s_type->fs_flags & FS_POWER_FREEZE))` to `if (!freeze_all_ptr && !(sb->s_type->fs_flags & FS_POWER_FREEZE))`. The CVE description confirms this reverse check causes all filesystems to be frozen when `filesystem_freeze_enabled` is false, leading to a WARN_ON_ONCE() in `__set_task_frozen()`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix inverted condition in filesystem freeze callback to correctly skip filesystems not participating in power freeze when not freezing all.
intent_record.what: Changed the condition in `filesystems_freeze_callback` from `if (freeze_all_ptr && !(sb->s_type->fs_flags & FS_POWER_FREEZE))` to `if (!freeze_all_ptr && !(sb->s_type->fs_flags & FS_POWER_FREEZE))`, adding a logical NOT before `freeze_all_ptr`.
intent_record.how: The early return behavior is inverted: previously the function returned early when `freeze_all_ptr` was non-null and the filesystem lacked FS_POWER_FREEZE; now it returns early when `freeze_all_ptr` is null (or false) and the filesystem lacks FS_POWER_FREEZE, altering which superblocks are processed for freezing.

candidates.rationale: The condition uses freeze_all_ptr instead of !freeze_all_ptr, causing the early skip to happen only when freeze_all_ptr is true, but it should happen when freeze_all_ptr is false to avoid freezing non-participating filesystems incorrectly.

vuln_statements.explanation: The boolean condition is reversed: it uses 'freeze_all_ptr' instead of '!freeze_all_ptr', causing the early return for non-FS_POWER_FREEZE filesystems to occur only when freeze_all_ptr is true, rather than when it is false. This results in incorrectly freezing all filesystems when freeze_all_ptr is false.
